en: A colorized panoramic view over a European city with red-roofed buildings and a prominent, forested hill rising from the middle of the urban area. On top of the hill are several structures, likely fortifications or a tower. A river with bridges runs through the city to the right. The sky is lightly clouded. At the top of the postcard is printed text in German: "Graz von der Rainerwarte."
